`root>body` is the block to edit.

Reasoning: the report says `padding: 4px` declared by `root>body` inside its `> panel` block is currently shadowing `padding: 32px` declared by `root>body>panel` itself. So the effective padding comes from `root>body`, not from `root>body>panel`. To make the panel render with `32px` padding, change the declaration in `root>body`'s CSS block.

ANSWER: root>body
